name: Long question with pauses (about 30 s, real time)
say: I want to ask you something about what is on my screen right now.
segments: I want to ask you something about what is on my screen right now.
I have been working on this for a while, and I keep losing track of where things are.
So first, tell me which app is in front.
And then, after that, tell me where the close button is, and point at it for me please.
